adopt.pattern: Draft/publish versioning with the engine cloned per version, frozen on each call, edits that never publish, prod/staging tags
adopt.evidence: Publish freezes in place, PATCH on published returns 422, create-agent-version clones agent AND engine, calls freeze the tag (O, A RAP-12/13; context evidence.2026-10-20.acct-retell-version-model). Contrast Vapi where every PATCH publishes.
adopt.why: Safe change for a client who only talks to an LLM operator; every call is reproducible against the exact version that ran.

adopt.pattern: Price at every choice point: per-row price in pickers, a live cost/latency/token strip, and price at the toggle
adopt.evidence: W section 13; png/09-model-dropdown.png ($0.064/min beside each model), png/04-agent-builder-top.png (0.134 = 0.055+0.015+0.064), png/76-workflow-tab.png (memory $0.005/run), png/5x-settings.png (burst $0.10). Decision node decision.2026-10-21.wt-synthesis-must-be-changes item A.
adopt.why: Trust and the cost-aware stack choice VP wants; extend with telephony, India-measured latency and an all-in INR per minute, which Retell omits.

adopt.pattern: Live control plane: listen, take over, inject context into a running call, force a regenerate
adopt.evidence: update-live-call call_control.additional_context (transcript role injected), listen-live subscribe-only token, take-over permanently stops the agent (O, A RAP-40; T RET-07).
adopt.why: Lets VP's supervisor agent or a human steer a call in progress; ideal for the LLM-driven operator model. Add consent and audit trail.

adopt.pattern: Lifecycle view per agent: pre-call functions, call, post-call extraction, memory save, post-call functions
adopt.evidence: png/76-workflow-tab.png (W wt-retell-37); A RAP-17 pre_session_tools/post_session_tools as a dependency graph.
adopt.why: One mental model for setup; VP fills the slots with pre-call lookup, call, extraction, WhatsApp/SMS/callback follow-up.

adopt.pattern: Transfer modes explained in plain words: cold, warm (one-way brief), agentic warm (two-way then bridge), with caller-ID choice and talk-while-waiting
adopt.why: Best transfer UX in the set; VP adds the warm brief spoken in Hindi/English and Indian CLI handling.

adopt.pattern: Stepped, persistent Getting-started checklist with locked dependent steps and per-step previews, plus page-aware assistant chips
adopt.evidence: png/71-home-onboarding-conductor.png, png/41-call-history.png (chips 'Filter failed calls'); about 4 clicks and 0 required fields to a testable agent (I, wt-retell-05).
adopt.why: Cuts time to first call; VP's chat operator can drive the same checklist for the client.

adopt.pattern: Copilot edits as per-setting diffs a human accepts, with failed calls turned into simulation tests
adopt.evidence: Conductor (O, T RET-03, RET-58): diffs, 30 free credits/day, vendor says it handles 70% of Retell's own simulation testing (V).
adopt.why: Safe LLM-driven change with a gate; VP adds statistics (ledger LRN-09; rejected.2026-10-17.k2-dashboards) and no self-grading.

adopt.pattern: Typed per-product per-second cost lines and per-component latency on every call record
adopt.evidence: call_cost.product_costs[] {product, unit_price cents/sec, cost}, latency {asr, llm, tts, e2e, kb, s2s}, llm_token_usage (O, A RAP-36/51).
adopt.why: Enables per-campaign and per-contact cost, which 0 of 5 API-visible vendors offer (account-phase XS-27/28).

adopt.pattern: Idempotency key on call creation, per-call agent override, and a pre-answer inbound webhook that can reject or reroute
adopt.evidence: create-phone-call idempotency_key (1 h), agent_override, retell_llm_dynamic_variables; call_inbound POST before the call exists (O, A RAP-38/42).
adopt.why: Prevents duplicate dials and lets enterprise systems decide per call; fits VP's consent and suppression predicate at dial time.

adopt.pattern: Diagnostics depth: 39 disconnection reasons, PCAP download, rerunnable post-call analysis, custom typed post-call fields written back to contacts with backfill
adopt.why: Finding a failed call and its reason is the top operator task; VP adds a business-outcome code beside the engineering reason.

adopt.pattern: Reserved-concurrency control with an allocation readout, multi-range calling windows with days of week
adopt.why: Keeps inbound capacity safe during campaigns; VP defaults windows to TRAI-legal IST ranges.

adopt.pattern: Memory discipline: one rewritten brief that keeps only what changes what the agent says or does, drops resolved items, guesses no sentiment or personality, treats the transcript as data
adopt.evidence: Default update prompt read at GET /get-crm-config (O, A RAP-32; T RET-57); read ON, update OFF, USD 0.005/run (D, png/76).
adopt.why: A sane floor for VP v2 memory; VP adds structure, consent, edit and delete, and surfaces the per-contact cost at the toggle.

adopt.pattern: Cross-provider TTS failover (fallback_voice_ids) and rich per-node turn-taking overrides (STT mode, responsiveness, interruption, boosted keywords)
adopt.evidence: A RAP-15/18; accepted in a single create call.
adopt.why: Resilience and tuning surface for Hinglish; VP exposes them in ms with Hindi-aware labels and adds carrier failover, which no vendor shows.

adopt.pattern: Fixed, plain-language roles on a trial and an API that is 1:1 with the SDK and MCP (109 operations, no hidden routes)
adopt.evidence: png/6z-roles.png (Admin, Developer, Member); A RAP-03/07 (Stainless-generated SDK and MCP from one spec).
adopt.why: One spec generating API, SDK and MCP is the cheapest route to VP's 'everything the dashboard does is also a chat/API operation' rule (decision.2026-10-20.acct-retell-api-parity-for-chat-setup).

beat.gap: India compliance is absent at dial time: 0 TRAI/DLT/NCPR/DPDP mentions in 338 docs pages; DNC off by default and skipped by batch; batch form has no consent/DND field; window default 00:00-23:59 with no legal-hours warning
beat.how_vp_beats: Suppression, consent, category-aware windows (09:00-21:00 promo) and DND/NCPR checked on every path before dial, shown on the campaign form. Test T2 messy 50-row CSV with an opt-out row: pass = 0 rings on the opt-out row and 0 after opt-out carried to a second campaign; Retell predicted to dial it (RET-P04e, p=0.85, unscored). Kill if 2+ incumbents already score 0.
beat.evidence: T RET-42/43/44; W wt-retell-45/46; context W1.

beat.gap: Contact hygiene: '9000000001' stored as +19000000001, '12345' stored verbatim, +91 and 0-prefixed variants coexist, exact-string dedupe only
beat.how_vp_beats: One contact object normalised to E.164 with India as the default, cross-format dedupe, impossible numbers flagged before any dial. Test: 50-row messy CSV, pass = 48 of 50 or more rows right in under 5 minutes; kill if incumbents' median is 45 of 50 or better.

beat.gap: Reply gap on Indian PSTN is not shown or optimised: no dashboard sums settings into a predicted gap; Retell-operated SIP/API hosts are US-West; predicted handset p50 1.6-2.4 s, p90 above 2.8 s (unmeasured)
beat.how_vp_beats: India-hosted media and brain, a predicted reply gap on the agent page. Test: handset stereo recording, 30+ clean turns, pass = VP p50 at least 0.3 s below the best incumbent, p90 2.5 s or less, cut-ins 5% or less. Caveat: Retell's legacy LiveKit web edge reaches Hyderabad, so record the SDP media address from each PCAP before claiming it.
beat.evidence: T RET-P09, RET-25, RET-61/62; W wt-retell-31; context W3.

beat.gap: Hinglish and Indic hold: 6 of 63 locales Indian, no Hinglish option, Hindi digits mis-transcribed, Marathi drift, no Telugu/Bengali/Gujarati/Malayalam/Punjabi/Odia, no Indian-accent voice in the picker, no Indic pronunciation alphabet
beat.how_vp_beats: Hinglish as a first-class mode with a visible language-hold control, Indic number reading, Hindi-tagged voices and Indic-script pronunciation. Test: battery with fixed n, language ID per turn plus digit/time content checks; pass = 95% or more and better than Retell (predicted 1 in 8 wrong turns, RET-P10, unscored). Drop if Sarvam or SquadStack is at or above VP.
beat.evidence: T RET-16, t/2713, t/2502, t/1645; A RAP-26/29/30; W wt-retell-24/25; context W5.

beat.gap: Time to first ring on an Indian handset from an Indian CLI: Persona government-ID KYC (one person per account) before any country or price, US/CA numbers only, BYO trunk with Plivo/Vobiz friction
beat.how_vp_beats: Pre-provisioned or BYO Indian number path with KYC time and cost stated before commitment. Test T0: sign-up to first ring; pass = 15 min or less against incumbents' median 45 min or more (Retell predicted over 30 min and 45-120 min via BYO, RET-P01); kill if Bolna or Sarvam is at 20 min or less.
beat.evidence: T RET-12/45, RET-P01/P02; W wt-retell-43; context W7.

beat.gap: Price: Retell infra line alone is USD 0.055 (about INR 5.2/min); all-in INR 8.3-13.6 on a BYO Indian trunk, 16.7-20.0 if the 4k rule scales the whole call, 22-37 on Retell US numbers
beat.how_vp_beats: Target INR 2-3 all-in with a worse-voice-never rule. Honest limit: incumbents carry 72-86% infra margin and can cut price, so price is a supporting win, not the wedge (rejected.2026-10-17.parity-undercut). Test T7 invoice audit: invoice matches VP's rate card within 1%.

beat.gap: Billing opacity and silent cost raisers: prompts over 4,000 tokens scale billed duration (814 tokens used by an empty prompt), 10 s minimum on dynamic openers, burst ON by default (+0.10/min), 10-minute silence and 1-hour call defaults, prepaid USD credits that stop calls at zero, no spend cap by API key
beat.how_vp_beats: Bounded call/spend defaults, surcharges off until chosen, per-second or short pulses, a single fee line, cost per campaign and contact, a spend cap on the API. Test: 10 calls each at 30, 45 and 90 s, invoice vs rate card; interviews must rank billing in the top 5 or drop this.
beat.evidence: T RET-34; W wt-retell-10, wt-retell-29, 5x-settings; context W8; decision.2026-10-21.wt-synthesis-must-be-changes item C.

beat.gap: BFSI post-sale calls need 1600-series numbers; Retell sells US/CA numbers only and its +1-to-India route is out
beat.how_vp_beats: 1600-series routing and DLT/header plumbing for insurance-renewal and other regulated service calls, with series chosen by call category. Test: a regulated service call placed from a 1600 number end to end; Retell cannot run it.
beat.evidence: T RET-64 (I), ledger REG-10/20; decision beachhead-v2.

beat.gap: Support in Indian hours: active support 9 AM-9 PM PST (21:30-09:30 IST, 22:30-10:30 after 2026-11-01), auto-ack then templated citation-style answers
beat.how_vp_beats: Human support in IST business hours (an operating promise, not product). Test T8: ticket filed at 11:00 IST; pass = answered in under 2 h against incumbents' median over 24 h; kill if incumbents' median is under 4 h.

beat.gap: The API cannot do what the dashboard does: CSV contact import is JWT-only, no export creation, batch is create-only (no status, cancel, retry), no billing/balance/member/workspace/aggregate-analytics routes; its MCP has 2 tools (search_docs, execute)
beat.how_vp_beats: Every dashboard action is an API/MCP operation under the same auth (bulk import with mapping, export, batch status/cancel/retry/pacing, billing and spend caps, funnels), so the LLM operator can do the whole job. Test: scripted end-to-end campaign setup through MCP only, with zero dashboard steps.

beat.gap: AI disclosure depends on the creation path: dashboard agents get the AI Disclosure When Asked preset, API-created agents have no handbook_config; presets are fixed text; nothing is non-removable
beat.how_vp_beats: Disclosure default-on on every creation path including API/MCP, light and once, with the effective setting visible on the agent record and enforced by predicate not instruction. Test: 4 dashboard-created and 4 API-created agents, 'aap AI ho?' in 8 calls; pass = 8 of 8 honest, 0 denials (Retell predicted 7 of 8, RET-P12).
beat.evidence: A RAP-19/20; T RET-63, RET-P12; rejected.harvest.03.

beat.gap: Campaign depth: one window per batch, no retries, no pacing, no per-lead windows, no attempt budget, no agent selector, Send disabled with no reason; the Campaigns object is hidden
beat.how_vp_beats: Campaign as a first-class object with per-lead windows, retries and attempt budgets, an agent selector, a stated reason on every disabled action, and a whole-campaign view with per-call AI analysis. Test: campaign battery (windows, retries, opt-out carry-over) scored against Retell's batch form.
beat.evidence: T RET-05; A RAP-39/41; W wt-retell-44/45; decision.2026-10-21.wt-synthesis-must-be-changes items B and D.

beat.gap: Memory and learning are thin and gated: one 2,000-character text brief per phone number, saving off by default; A/B is fixed weights with no statistics; Conductor fixes need a human; marketing outruns the docs
beat.how_vp_beats: v2: consented, editable, structured per-contact memory with its cost shown at the toggle; learning with honest statistics (power-aware bandit, no daily-peeking K=2 dashboards, no cross-tenant pooling). Test: A/A false-winner rate and per-tenant lift; pass only on measured lift, since 'self-learning' dashboards give 52-62% false winners (rejected.2026-10-17.k2-dashboards).
beat.evidence: T RET-57/58, RET-08; ledger LRN-09, CMP-01; rejected.2026-10-17.cross-tenant-pooling.

beat.how_vp_beats: Empty states with a CTA, Sample labels, page-scoped tours, a stated reason on disabled buttons, India-shaped templates (renewal, payment reminder), Aadhaar/PAN in PII, a visible transcriber choice. Test: task-failure counts on a scripted first-run walk at 1280 px and phone width, VP vs the screenshots listed.
